name: Arena Shift
description: One arena, one simulation, two Pocket Works generations. Switch live between Classic and Forge rendering while the same fight continues.
changelog: Launch release with a shared combat simulation and live Classic/Forge renderer switching.
Adds touch-first arena combat, upgrades, escalating waves, boss encounter and persisted best run.
Forge mode is authored for the Godot Web runtime and consumes Blender and Audio Forge outputs.
